label: Embryo-derived hCG input
notes: Do not model trophoblast production internally in the maternal-only network.

label: Generic embryo-conditioned signal
notes: Use only when hCG/contact-specific information is unavailable.

label: Excess endoplasmic-reticulum stress
notes: Represents pathological excess, not physiological decidual ER stress.

label: Excessive ECM/stromal stiffness
measurable: AFM Young modulus or hydrogel modulus
notes: Prefer a graded rate modifier in PhysiBoSS; Boolean input is a coarse sensitivity variable.

label: Epithelial/glandular LIF
notes: Hard attachment gate in mouse; direct human causality is weaker.

label: High epithelial KLF12
notes: Human recurrent implantation failure evidence; not required in first extension.

label: Epithelial LIFR/GP130-STAT3 activity
notes: Candidate central attachment gate and remodeling driver.

label: Stromal STAT3 activity
logic_hint: stromal LIF/IL6-family cue and decidual state
notes: Later support rather than sole initial attachment gate.

label: Stromal HAND2
notes: Suppresses stromal FGF output and epithelial proliferative nonreceptivity.

label: Stromal mitogenic FGF output
notes: Collapsed family-level state; avoid selecting a specific FGF without data.

label: Epithelial estrogen-driven proliferative state
logic_hint: IN_E2 and S_FGF_MITOGENIC and not S_HAND2
notes: Should be suppressed during receptivity.

label: Epithelial PODXL barrier
notes: Forced ON should suppress adhesion competence.

label: Epithelial CD98/CD9 complex
notes: Use as a rate accelerator or redundant route.

label: Apical epithelial CDH1/CTNND1 state
notes: Do not conflate apical adhesion CDH1 with lateral junctional CDH1.

label: ANXA2-RHOA-F-actin remodeling
logic_hint: uncertain: receptive state or embryo-conditioned activation
notes: Single main mechanistic literature line; keep as rate modifier.

label: Epithelial HB-EGF
notes: Likely support/rate modifier rather than hard gate.

label: Epithelial PCSK5/PC6 activity
notes: Window-specific protease with direct attachment evidence.

label: Full-length alpha-dystroglycan barrier
notes: Barrier state.

label: PC6-cleaved alpha-dystroglycan state
notes: Barrier-release state; can be complementary to E_DAG1_FULL.

label: Anti-adhesive MUC1 glycocalyx state
notes: Avoid a single MUC1 node because human glycoforms can be pro-adhesive.

label: Glyco-permissive MUC1 sLeX-like state
notes: Moderate early-contact rate enhancer.

label: Epithelial alphaVbeta3/alphaVbeta5 integrin state
notes: Human cell-model and primate support; receptor-side assignment depends on assay.

label: Stromal SPP1/osteopontin
notes: Separate from existing epithelial E_SPP1_EXPR.

label: Stromal TAZ/WWTR1 ECM-remodeling state
notes: Recent evidence; use sensitivity analysis.

label: Balanced decidual senescence/remodeling state
notes: Biphasic; do not equate all senescence with failure.

label: Mechanical and dynamic ECM permissiveness
measurable: AFM stiffness, matrix dynamics, collagen architecture
logic_hint: S_TAZ_ECM and S_DECIDUALIZED and not IN_ER_STRESS_EXCESS and not IN_HIGH_ECM_STIFFNESS
notes: Bridge to later PhysiBoSS matrix fields.

label: Epithelial receptive adhesive surface
logic_hint: STAT3 gate, barriers OFF, at least one positive effector ON
notes: Human evidence supports a multicomponent surface transition rather than one master receptor.

label: LGALS1/LGALS3 interface state
notes: Computationally prioritized; needs perturbational confirmation.

label: BSG-ITGB1 interface state
notes: Expansion candidate only.

label: Uterine WNT5A/WNT7A embryo-competence cue
notes: Embryo execution is outside the maternal-only MaBoSS network.
